Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone PNG game prop sprite, not a sheet.
Reference: supplied sprite sheet is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate the ONE object described below independently, with newly drawn details at its native proportions.
Style: match reference faithfully: polished simple top-down arcade prop, warm sandstone / dusty warm-gray stone / muted slate metal / medium-brown timber as appropriate, tiny amber accents, soft bevels, broad readable surface details, subtle upper-left light and lower-right shading. Simple restrained textures, not realistic, no extra decoration. 
Camera: exactly overhead, each prop centered, top dominates, slight 3D depth. Buildings and crates have inset tops with thin shallow outward-flaring wall bands visible on ALL FOUR sides. No isometric projection, no large front wall. Pyramid edges horizontal and vertical, never rotated diamonds.
Collision silhouette: one clean filled axis-aligned rectangle (with only tiny corner bevels) or circle, as specified. All detail must lie inside this silhouette. No projecting doors, pipes, stones or bolts. No ground plate, detached parts, debris, scenery, cast shadows outside footprint, glow outside footprint, floating pixels, labels, text, UI or watermark.
Background: actual fully TRANSPARENT alpha, clean edges, never a painted checkerboard or opaque background. Center sprite with at least 7% transparent margin each side; fill about 80% of canvas longest dimension. Prefer 1024x1024 canvas. Keep object's specified aspect ratio even on square canvas. Output only the one sprite.

Remove ALL background, the black backdrop and the gray halo/cast shadow around the crate. Outside the solid crate silhouette must be genuinely transparent alpha, not black, white or a checkerboard. Clean isolated cutout on real transparent background. Keep transparent padding. No extra shadow or glow beyond object outline. Output PNG with alpha.
